lessons.title: Have I switched my faith?
lessons.quote: One Lord, one faith, one baptism (Ephesians 4:5)

content.data: When we receive Jesus Christ as our Lord, other people might accuse us of switching faith. We can experience feelings of guilt and feel like we betrayed someone. Let us explore this issue further.
Ephesians 4:5 says that there is one Lord, one faith, and one baptism. Then why are there so many churches, you may ask?

My parents have fourteen children. Almost all my brothers and sisters have their own families, and they are all different. They have different habits, education, and lifestyles. Some live in cities, and some live in villages. They have different jobs and characters. They dress differently, cook differently, and raise their children differently. But we all have something in common: our father and our mother. We all love our parents very much, and our parents love us.

Do you see my point here? Just like families, churches are, were, and will be different. But we all have something in common: our Lord Jesus Christ! He is our Spiritual Father. My faith is in God, and I love Him. It is not possible to switch faith because there is only one God! All Christians believe in the same God!

Once, I heard my four children arguing, and my youngest son cried, «Mother is mine!» The other two children shouted, «No, she is mine!» They were ready to fight when suddenly the oldest son said, «Wait, she is ours.»
We, the children of the Heavenly Father, must understand that we, as churches (families), are different. But our Father, our faith, and our love are one!
You cannot switch faith. You can either believe in God or not!

When I got married, I did not betray my mother. She always remained my mother. My mother is one person, and my wife is another. Church is one thing, and God is another. Never confuse God with the church. Thus, you did not switch faith; you have simply begun to believe!
I congratulate you and wish you have strong faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. And now, here is a little workshop.

lessons.title: What would people say?
lessons.quote: I care very little if I am judged by you or by any human court; indeed, I do not even judge myself. My conscience is clear, but that does not make me innocent. It is the Lord who judges me. (1 Corinthians 4:3-4)

content.data: Our entire life, we are trying to please other people. We often prepare dinner for our guests just to look good in front of our neighbors. We try to accommodate and please our co-workers, neighbors, friends, and relatives

Apostle Paul writes in 1 Corinthians 4:3-4 that God’s opinion should be the most important for us, not people’s opinion. After they come to Jesus, people often worry: «What will my wife or husband say?», «What about my girlfriend or boyfriend, my co-workers, or that caustic neighbor?» We do not know what to do, what to say to those people, and whether or not we should let them know about our decision to believe in Jesus.
Other people often say offensive things that hurt us, and we become slaves to their opinions.

Once, I traveled to Norway through Finland with my team on an evangelism trip. In Finland, we boarded a big Swedish passenger ship. Our Norwegian friends told us that our lower-class tickets did not include private rooms and food. We asked several workers on the ship to make sure, and the answer was always the same. So we just took places where we could, unpacked our food, and got ready to spend the night where we were. I dozed off in a chair on the upper deck. Suddenly, one of our team members woke me up and said that cabins and meals were available for all of us. I moved into my cabin. It was a good room, and the restaurant had plenty of food. It was all included in our tickets! I asked him how he learned about these wonderful accommodations. It turned out that he went to a senior officer on the ship, and that man permitted us to have food and accommodation with our tickets. Many people advised us on how to better accommodate ourselves on the deck, but it turned out that only the opinion of the senior officer was important to us.
The opinion of the person with wisdom and authority is most important.

For example, it is essential to know the doctor’s opinion about your health, a farmer’s opinion about seeds, and an architect’s opinion about construction, is it not? Can you imagine a musician assisting a surgeon during an operation or a farmer helping a computer programmer?
Life, death, eternity, and salvation belong to God’s wisdom and authority. It is only His opinion and His Word that matter!

lessons.title: Believing is not boring!
lessons.quote: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon’s Colonnade. No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people. Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number. As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by. Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by impure spirits, and all of them were healed. (Acts 5:12-16)

content.data: Many people, especially young adults, are afraid to receive Jesus Christ, thinking that their lives will become boring. Many young people think that the Bible is a code of prohibitions.
In the early church, we see that Christian life was vibrant, joyful, and exciting without sin!

I want to assure you that there are no prohibitions in the Bible, only warnings and advice. The Bible is an instruction book for life and death. A sign on a bottle that says, «Caution: poison» is not a prohibition but a warning! Sin looks good only on the outside. Inside, it is poison. It leads to very difficult consequences for our lives, health, and finances and often even affects our children and grandchildren. The Bible does not limit us. It warns us!

Once, I was asked to check the quality of a concrete mixer’s electrical connection. Having an electrician diploma, I am well aware of the operating rules for electrical installations. I found many mistakes during the examination: bare wires, no ground connection, etc. Then, I told the operators that they should not use the concrete mixer. They mocked me, «Look at this newbie know-it-all!» and let me go. An hour later, I learned that one of the workers was killed. They did not want to follow the rules. Rules are not made for the young or the old, for the wise or the unwise. They are made for everybody! It is a warning! What would happen if no one followed the rules on the road? It would be total chaos!

Jesus Christ gives us a new, wonderful life full of His blessings! You may ask, «But what will I have instead of my loud friends and vibrant parties?» You will have a hundred times more! The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and you will have a very loud, joyful, but pure friendship of God.

Jesus Christ gives us new joy, friends, feelings, opportunities, a new meaning in life, forgiveness of sins, a cleansed conscience, renewed family, beautiful relationships with God and people, blessings in health and finances, and eternal life! You will not become bored with Him! It is a wonderful life!

lessons.title: Will I be able to do it?
lessons.quote: Find Ephesians 2:1-9 in the Bible and read it

content.data: The passage says that all people follow someone’s will. It is either God’s will or the Devil’s. You will say: «No, I lived my way.»

Once, I talked to a chronic smoker. He said, «I can smoke, and I can stop smoking. I am free». Then I told him, «You can only smoke. You are not able to quit. If you could, you would have done it a long time ago». He was, in fact, a slave to cigarettes. The Bible says that a person who sins is a slave to sin. The Devil is the father of sin. A person who sins follows the Devil’s will. How many sins have enslaved us: anger, irritation, drunkenness, sexual immorality, lies? It is difficult to name them all.
You may say, «Exactly, that’s what I was afraid of. I would not be able to leave those things behind. I’ll first become a good person, and then I will come to God».
NO! You will never be able to become good by yourself. You need to give yourself to God, and then He will give you power to overcome sin!

Let us remember:
1. We are not able to become good on our own.
2. God has the power to overcome sin.
3. God wants to give us this power.

If you have a problem with your health, you need to see a doctor. You go to a hospital and entrust the doctor with your health. Who needs a doctor: the healthy or the sick? Who needs Jesus: the righteous or the sinners? If you entrust your life to Jesus, He will give you the power to overcome sin and various problems in His Name! You will not overcome all of your sins at once. You will not become a super saint in one day. It is a learning process.

Every day, you will learn more and more about the ways you can use the power Jesus gave you! Do not despair if you do not succeed on your first try. You will do it on your second or third attempt! You will definitely do it! Jesus gave us power, but it is not our power but God’s power.
You can do anything with Jesus!

lessons.title: Not everyone is worth following!
lessons.quote: Find Hebrews 12:1-2 in the Bible and read it.

content.data: Many people look at Christians who sin and are tempted by them. Questions arise, like «Why is this person doing that while another person is doing this?» Let us find out.

We are not called «Peterians,» «Johnians,» or «Philippians.» We are called CHRISTIANS, and Jesus Christ is our only ideal. It is written in the Bible that there is no person who does not sin. It is the teacher that students learn from, not other students. All students make mistakes, but the teacher is the one who teaches. He sets an example, and our example is Jesus! He did not sin. Read about Him in the four Gospels. What a life! Jesus faced so many trials and temptations, but there was not a single sin in his life! Do not look at people. Look at Jesus!

Once, I was giving a lift to a man who was a non-believer. We started talking about God. He told me, «I would have come to God, but I knew a Christian who stole from our local government. That’s why I will not do it. And you are all like him!» My response was, «Maybe that person stole, maybe some other Christians have committed even bigger sins, but I don’t believe in people. I believe in Jesus. Jesus never stole or lied». When we started talking about Jesus, that man began to cry. Never make excuses for other people, never judge them, and never focus on people. Look only at Jesus. If you discuss other people's sins, tomorrow they will discuss yours.

Once, my daughter asked me to teach her how to ride a bicycle. She would ride it as long as I ran alongside her and held the bicycle. But as soon as I let go, she would fall. I got tired and sat down to rest. Then, suddenly, I realized how I could teach her. I said, «Look forward, and do not look down at the wheel. Hold the handlebar and steer, aiming forward». And she did it!
Do not look down at your feet – there is a lot of dirt there. Look onward at Jesus! Then you will definitely get to your destination!!!
Chapter 26 of the Gospel of Matthew has an incredible story about the great Apostle Peter. At the time, he was a young and zealous disciple. Peter wanted everything at once. But when the

soldiers took Jesus and led Him to be crucified, Peter disowned Christ. Only when he met Jesus' gaze he understood everything and wept bitterly. Jesus forgave him because Peter was human, and people can stumble and sin. When Peter looked at people, he gave in to temptation, but when he looked at Jesus, he repented. Therefore:

Always look to Jesus!
Always learn from Jesus!
Always believe Jesus!

weeks.title: The cause of all problems is sin

lessons.title: How it all happened
lessons.quote: Read Chapters 1-3 of the book of Genesis

content.data: Today, we begin a new topic: The cause of all problems is sin. I believe you have noticed several things after reading the first three chapters of Genesis:

1) God created everything.
2) Adam and Eve were at the center of creation.
3) The Serpent (Devil) deceived people.
Let us review, step by step.

God created everything good. He did not plan sin, disease, famine, or war. Humans were His most important creation. Everything was created for them: Earth, the Universe, plants, and animals. What made humans different from animals, in your opinion? Was it their intellect, strength, or memory? It was more than that. Humans were created in God’s image and likeness and had the right to choose.

When Adam and Eve were given a choice (God explained everything to Adam): whether to have joy, happiness, prosperity, health, and eternity in obedience to God or to be independent and face death, disease, and poverty, they chose the latter option of independence. And along with that independence, they got all the problems we experience now. When I was a child, I used to think that if I were Adam, I would have chosen God. No! In the position of Adam and Eve, we all would have done the same.

There is an old story about a newlywed couple and a rich man. The couple grumbled about Adam and Eve. They said their lives would have been different if Adam and Eve had not done what they did. One rich Christian heard about this and met this newly married couple. He said he would provide them with everything they needed: a house, furniture, and money, but under one condition. There will be two plates on their table, one flipped on top of the other, and they are not allowed to open them. If they do it even once, they will lose everything they received from him. They were patient for a couple of days, but then, when the husband was not at home, the wife lifted the top plate a little, and suddenly, a mouse jumped out and ran away. The rich man came and told them to leave because of their unfaithfulness. The cause is not Adam or Eve. It is that humans are unable to live without God.
A child depends on their parents. People depend on God because He is our Father. He is the source of good. We need to be with God all the time. He is the primary source of all blessings in our lives!

Let us find out what sin is. What did Adam and Eve do? They disobeyed God. It was the first sin committed on Earth. But the primary sin was born in their hearts before that. It was rebellion (rejection of God’s laws). Rebellion caused disobedience to God.
REBELLION AGAINST GOD
What are the main issues in relationships between parents and children? They are disobedience and rebellion.

The root of all sinі is not murder or theft. These are the results of the primary sin. Adam and Eve doubted (rebelled against) God’s words. Rebellion gave birth to disobedience, upon which all other sins and wickedness people commit are based.
How can we get rid of the primary sin? You have to say no to your ego. In other words, you must give up the right to rule your life and give this right to God, the Creator of life.
And what is the primary source of blessings? It is giving your life to Jesus and obeying Him.
To get rid of bad fruit (sins) in your life, you have to fight their roots! You need to cut them off! Ask God to plant a seed of a new life! Do it right now!
PRAY TOGETHER WITH ME:
«Dear Jesus. I give up my rebellion and disobedience. I give all my life to you. Be my Lord (Master), change me, and teach me to obey you, my Lord. Amen».

When reading this passage of the Scripture, we see that there is someone behind all evil. He is a fallen angel. God banished him from Heaven for his pride. He has many names in the Bible, two of which are the most common. The first one, «devil,» means accuser, and «satan» means enemy. Other names are «old serpent,» «father of lies,» «liar,» «dragon,» «antichrist,» and others. All these names reveal the nature of the devil.

Recently, I read in a newspaper about two criminals caught by police. They were husband and wife and wanted to steal money from a rich man. They tried different ways, but everything failed. They couldn’t do it. Then, they kidnapped his son, and demanded a $70,000 ransom. They found his one weakness: his child. The wealthy man immediately agreed to give them the money, but fortunately, the police quickly arrested the criminals. To attack God, the devil has found His most precious creation: you and I and all the other people in the world.
People are more precious to God than anything else on Heaven and Earth. God gave His Son, Jesus Christ, for us.
The devil pursues people to hurt God. He is a sly and cunning enemy because he knows God loves people the most.

Many years ago, there was a conflict between the USSR and China. The Chinese came up with a trick. They formed a rank of women holding their little children and placed them in front of their army. There were many soldiers and tanks behind the human shield. No one knew what to do. No one wanted to kill women and children. Then, one officer got the idea to put mines in the field and put up signs in Chinese that read: «Women, stop! Do not kill your children!» When the Chinese women read the signs, they stopped and did not move further into the minefield.
That is similar to what the devil does. He does not attack us directly. He tempts a person close to us, incites us against each other, and gleefully watches from afar.

Many laws exist in both the spiritual and the physical worlds. The effects and consequences of these laws do not depend on the people's authority. They work because they are laws. Let us consider one important law called «The law of sin and death.» Keep your Bible open. We will read James 1:13-15 one more time.
Let us define this law in our own words: my plans, intentions, and desires will surely lead to disagreement with God, which will result in the complete failure of my life.

I spoke about this law with a man who said, «I do not believe this. Everything’s fine with me. I plan my life by myself». I told him, «There is the law of gravity. Imagine that you do not believe it. You can stand on the top floor, shout, «I don’t believe this law!», and bravely step forward. What is going to happen? You will fall to death. The point is that this law works regardless of whether you believe it. It operates beyond the human sphere of influence.»

The Bible says that desire gives birth, and sin gives birth. What does it mean? It means it is a process that may occur the next day or in a decade. A woman does not give birth in a single moment. It is a process that takes 9 months. Likewise, sooner or later, desire will give birth to sin, and sin will give birth to death. It will definitely happen.
You might ask if it is possible to stop this law from taking effect. No, it is not possible for a human. What to do then? Look what God has done through Jesus Christ. Isaiah 53:4-6 says:

«Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering, yet we considered him punished by God, stricken by him, and afflicted. But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed. We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.»
This is the only way! Jesus took up my sin and all its consequences (He suffered and died) and has risen from the dead because He was the righteous Son of God.
READ ACTS 4:12
«Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved.»
People who have met Jesus on Earth have asked Him, «What must we do to do the works God requires?» Jesus answered that there are no such works but one, and it is to believe in Him.

«Then–you may say–why help the poor, go to church, do good things, and live honestly?» We need to do good things (we’ll talk about this later), but they have nothing to do with our salvation. It does not matter if a person is good or bad. In any case, there is no salvation without Christ. To receive salvation, someone must pay and accept punishment for sin, which is death.

Once, I met a very nice man. He was very hospitable, kind, respectful, and even a little shy. He really wanted to share a meal with me, and during our conversation, he mentioned that he had «recently returned». Later, I learned his story from other people. One night, he was driving a motorcycle and accidentally hit his neighbor, who fell and broke his arm. There was a court hearing, and he was sentenced to two years in a minimum security prison. I was surprised that such a good man had been put in prison! There are so many criminals walking the streets, and this man had to go to prison because of an accident. But, my dear friend, the law does not care if you are good or bad. If you broke the law, you must pay for it!
Do you see the point? If I have committed a single sin in my life, I am guilty. Only someone who will agree to take up my guilt and go to prison for me can save me.
And He is Jesus Christ! He died for me, was punished for me, set me free, and rose from the dead (walked out of prison). He is the Lord!

That’s why there is no other way but through Jesus Christ. Do not try to become good and then come to God. We can not become good without Him. Do not try to receive salvation through knowledge or by going to church (although we need to do it). Salvation is possible only through Jesus Christ. The devil has set up so many traps regarding this: «I will start in the New Year,» «I will live for myself just a bit, and then…», «I will raise my children and then come to God,» «I will build my house first,» «I will get married and repent.» All these things are lies. There is only one day when you can repent and give your life to Jesus, which is
TODAY!
After the last week’s lessons, you may ask, «Who is Jesus anyway?» Let us talk about Jesus Christ. Jesus Christ came into this world according to Biblical prophesies.

The Bible says that He always was! Jesus is the second person of the Trinity: God the Father, God the Son, and God the Holy Spirit. They are three personalities, but simultaneously, They are one! There are some very primitive examples, and may God forgive me that I dare to write them down:

Sun (one): light, warmth, energy (three)
Family (one): husband, wife, child (three)
Person (one): spirit, soul, body (three)
Christ was born to the Virgin Mary and (most important) through God the Holy Spirit! He was both God and human.

Why did Jesus become human? He did it to bring salvation to humanity. To understand an ant and help an ant, one must also become an ant! Seven days after His birth, He was given the name «Jesus» (in Hebrew, it means «Jehovah saves,» Jehovah is the name of God the Father). Thirty days later, He was dedicated to God through a priest’s prayer. (You can also dedicate your children to God).
Until Jesus turned thirty, He lived like an ordinary man, studying and perceiving human life. He helped His father, Joseph, who was a carpenter.

At the age of thirty, Jesus was baptized in water by John the Baptist in the Jordan River. (You can also be baptized in water). Right after that, Jesus was baptized with the Holy Spirit (You can also experience it; we will talk about it later). For three and a half years, Jesus walked on Earth, preached the Kingdom of God (Gospel), healed the sick and lame, drove out evil spirits, performed miracles, and raised the dead. When Jesus was thirty-three and a half, He was arrested by jealous chief priests. They gave Jesus to Pilate, the Roman governor. The governor did not find Him guilty and wanted to let Jesus go, but the priests incited rebellion. Given no choice, Pilate handed Jesus over for crucifixion. It was the way the worst criminals were punished in those times. Jesus was beaten, mocked, insulted, and finally crucified with His arms and legs nailed to the cross. He died on the same night. His tomb was guarded, but God resurrected Jesus from the dead through God the Holy Spirit! He became Jesus Christ (in Hebrew, «the Messiah, the Anointed, the Chosen for Salvation»).

God the Father gave His Son all authority on Heaven and Earth. Jesus received the power to forgive sins, heal, and judge people according to their deeds. Jesus Christ received the title of the King of the Universe. He received it legally by paying for your and my salvation with His life.

Why Jesus?
Because He was without sin.
Because He died willingly.
Because He loved so much.
Without Jesus, everyone would have died!
If you acknowledge Jesus as your Lord and ask Him for forgiveness, repenting of your sins, He will forgive you.
What to do now? The Bible says that we shall not sin, but if we do, we must confess our sin (say it aloud) before God, and He will forgive us.
Warning!!! The devil has two traps set here:

1) You are so sinful that God will not forgive you. It’s a lie! The Blood of Jesus can cleanse you of any sin.
2) Sin as much as you want. God will forgive you anyway. It’s a lie! The Bible says that to the devious God shows himself shrewd.
Beware! Do not get caught in these traps of the devil!
So, I have fought with some sin. For instance, dishonesty, but I failed and lied to someone. How to receive forgiveness?
Here is an example of a prayer of repentance for lying:

1. Proclaim Christ as the Lord.
«Dear Jesus, I proclaim You as my Lord. I love You and thank You for everything».
2. Acknowledge your fault and repent.
«Jesus, I want to repent now before You. I have sinned, and I acknowledge it».
3. Confess.
«I confess that I lied to my friend in the morning. Forgive me».
4. Receive forgiveness by faith.
«I receive forgiveness through Your Holy Blood and am cleansed from dishonesty».
5. Gratitude.
«I thank You from the bottom of my heart that You have forgiven me. You are righteous, merciful, and good, Jesus. You are my Lord».
This is just an example of how to pray for repentance.
I pray this prayer every day. There is no person who does not sin.
Of course, the level of sin may differ: one man may have killed someone, and another just had a bad thought. Yet both of them need forgiveness through Jesus Christ.
Let us read together a parable Jesus told in the Gospel in Luke 18:9-14:

«To some who were confident of their own righteousness and looked down on everyone else, Jesus told this parable: ‘Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector. The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other people – robbers, evildoers, adulterers – or even like this tax collector. I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.’ “But the tax collector stood at a distance. He would not even look up to heaven, but beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner.’ “I tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.»
Remember that God loves all people, but He forgives only those who repent.
I want to give you some advice:

lessons.title: The power of the Blood of Christ

content.data: In 1983, I was discharged from the army. I became a part-time student and found a job. I also worked a lot in the church as a choir leader, evangelist, and youth leader. Two years later, I started building my own house. I did not have money, so I had to do everything by myself. Sunday was my only day off, so I had to build my house during lunchtime and late at night. I would take a train to church almost every day, and I had to walk 3 kilometers to the train station. I could not get good food because all the money was used for construction. It was normal for me to fill a few cubic meters of cement or unload a truckload of sand with a shovel during my lunch break. I had worked under such pressure for five years. During that time, our evangelism team conducted about a hundred meetings in Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Cherkasy regions. One night, after a church service, I got a headache. I have never experienced such terrible pain before. Neither prayer nor medicine helped. Then, the pain had gone, and suddenly, I felt that my strength had left me. First, it was hard to work a full week, then it was difficult to endure one day, and then I could only last for an hour. Finally, I could not even lift ten kilograms. I fainted very often and had to stay in bed for weeks. I needed several days to gather my strength to attend a Sunday service. There came a moment when I realized that this is the end.

Then I began to pray, asking God, «Why? I have been doing so much for You. Why did I become a walking corpse at only thirty?» There was no answer. I began to realize that I would die soon. My strength was leaving me. I had numerous medical checkups and received various treatments. I weighed 60 kg, although I was 178 centimeters tall. Once, I went to my room to pray (the room was on the second floor, so it took me thirty minutes to climb up the stairs). I began to cry before God. Suddenly, I heard a clear voice. God told me, «Did you think that work, knowledge, or preaching matter in the spiritual world? No. You matter to me, but not because you have worked so much. You became invaluable at the very moment you received forgiveness through the Blood of My Son. I value His Blood, and therefore I am healing you». Since that day, I started getting better, and very soon, I fully recovered. I received healing, but, most importantly, I received a huge revelation: money, gold, beauty, power, and connections do not matter in the spiritual world. They mean nothing there! There is only one thing of value: the Blood of Jesus. The Father responds only to the Blood of His Son.
I would like to share a few lines from an old song known in almost every church worldwide.

The Blood of Jesus purifies from sin.
The Blood of Jesus gives the power
to overcome sin.
The Blood of Jesus gives us the ability
to be righteous.
When I was a child, I regretted that I was not born at the time when Jesus Christ lived on Earth. It would have been wonderful! Walk with Jesus, get healed, eat bread. Heavenly life!
After His resurrection, Jesus appeared to His disciples for 40 days and then ascended to His Father. Before the ascension, Jesus gathered His disciples and gave His farewell speech.
What did Jesus say?

1) (verse 18) All authority has been given to
Jesus. Everything depends on His decision
and not on leaders and governments.
2) (verse 19) We must go and tell about Jesus.
This is His «Great Commission.»
3) (verse 20) If we accept His authority and
preach about Him, He will always be with us!
«How can this happen?» you may ask. Notice that the third point will only occur if the first two are fulfilled. Did you get it? Let us move on.
In acknowledging Jesus authority and preaching the Gospel, we receive the blessing: «And surely I am with you always…»
Jesus will always be with us. How? Through God the Holy Spirit.

We receive authority from Jesus
through the Holy Spirit!
Jesus is always with us! It is an eternal promise. He never lies or fails us. He is never late!

Christ appointed us to be His representatives on Earth. He delegated His authority and power to us. We are privileged to be ambassadors extraordinary and plenipotentiary of the Heavenly Kingdom by the Lord Jesus Christ’s commission!
All governments care about and protect their ambassadors. Moreover, Jesus will care for and protect us! Jesus is always with us to the very end of time. Amen.

lessons.title: You can do it with Jesus!

content.data: «Good for you–you may say to me–you have been a believer since you were a child, you have a Christian family, your own house, you have received a good education, and you are a pastor of a church. What about me? How can I achieve all this?» I do not know who you are, my dear reader. Maybe you are a young man or woman… You want to serve Jesus, but you lack the strength. Your friends laugh at you, and there are so many temptations around you. And at home… Are you an older person? Is your health not so good? Maybe you do not have money? What to do then? Maybe you have small children, are very busy at work, or have a big garden and no one to work there. Perhaps nobody, absolutely no one, needs you in this life. What do you do?

At the beginning of my military service, I went through a big test of faith. Before joining the army, I exercised a lot and was ready for anything. But one morning, we, young soldiers, were ordered into formation, given gas masks, and ordered to run a 10 kilometer forced march. It seemed like it was no big deal, but the temperature was about 40 degrees Celsius. After I ran for several kilometers, I realized I could not make it. Sergeants stood at the end of every kilometer and beat those who fell and were unable to run, accusing them of faking it. Then I remembered Jesus and began to pray, “Jesus, help me! I can not stop. I need to get to the end”. Immediately, I felt an incredible burst of energy. I began to run faster. Suddenly, I heard the groans of a Kazakh soldier beside me. He was stumbling and asked for help. I grabbed him, and we ran together. Then, one more soldier joined us. And we made it! Jesus gave us strength!

You can also do it. It might not work for the first time. Maybe you will fall a few times, but do not get discouraged. Stand up and run forward! Never forget to ask Jesus to give you strength. Wherever you are: at school, work, or on a farm. Maybe you are going to a maternity hospital, washing dishes, creating computer software, or just driving your car. Always ask Jesus to help you. If someone tempts you to steal, fornicate, drink alcohol, or smoke cigarettes, pray!

Jesus will give you a great victory!
You can do everything with the
empowering help of Jesus Christ!

Today, we have a new subject: church. What do you know about church? Many people think it is a beautiful building or a collection of various rituals and traditions. But we need to know what God thinks about it (see Week 1, Lesson 2) and what the Bible tells us about church.
We just read Hebrews 10:25, which says that a church is an assembly of people. «What do we call the building we see?» you may ask. It is a temple.
Let us summarize:

1) The building where people gather to pray and worship God, with all its decorations and rituals, is a temple.
2) The people who gather to pray and worship God are a church.
Acts 2:46 says that the disciples of Jesus gathered:

1) in a temple;
2) in their homes.

We also need to join the church in a temple (Sunday worship) and our homes (during the week). Both places are very important, but we will talk about Sunday service in this lesson. Every Sunday morning, a Sunday service takes place. All people who belong to the local church gather together. The Bible says that we should not abandon (skip) services.

Is it possible to receive salvation without a church? What if you believe in your heart, pray quietly, do good things, read the Bible, and not sin? Practically, it is not possible. (We are not considering exceptions: uninhabited islands, spaceships, etc.). The Bible says we are the members of the Body of Christ, that is, the Church (1 Corinthians 12).

Imagine your finger decided to separate itself from the body and live on its own. How long will it last? Several minutes, perhaps. What if the head separates? Nothing good will come of it. The body can only live if its members stay together! You are not a church on your own but only together with other people!

Therefore, there is no reason not to go to church. The only exceptions are conditions that do not depend on us (serious illness, work shift). Church is a ship in the middle of the sea. You are either on board or overboard!

lessons.title: Home church is a spiritual family

content.data: Now we will talk about church gatherings in homes or home church. Sometimes, it is also called a home group or cell.
What is the purpose of a home church? Its primary purpose is to have fellowship and serve one another and the world.
The main church has teaching (sermons) of Apostles (pastors, preachers), worship, and strong prayer. This is also where many people receive Jesus (repent), and many are healed.
What takes place in a home church, then?
A home church is a spiritual family. It has spiritual parents and children. It is very important for you to become a part of a home church and love it.
A home church usually lasts for 1,5-2 hours. Everyone brings some food (if possible). You can bring children, relatives, and friends to a home church.

Even if you come for the first time, you can participate in the life of a home church. Home church members can take turns hosting home church meetings, if possible. It does not matter what apartment, furniture, or plates and dishes you have. A home church is a gathering not to observe but to serve. Remember that. There is one more important thing I want to say. Nobody needs anyone in the world today. IN A HOME CHURCH, YOU NEED PEOPLE AND PEOPLE NEED YOU. You will become an individual, one that is needed, loved, and appreciated. Value your home church!

lessons.title: What happens in a church and why?

content.data: What was your impression about your first visit to the church? «It was a little shocking» would be a likely response.
Let us look at what occurs during a church meeting (it is similar to what occurs in a home church).
Praise and worship

People rejoice and sing a lot. Singing can be provisionally divided into two parts: praise and worship. Praise is exalting God as the King and Lord. This is God’s etiquette: God receives our prayers if we praise and thank him. Praise is joyful, and worship is quiet and more intimate. Do not feel bad if you are confused. The ability to distinguish between praise and worship and enter into God’s presence comes with time. It is a process. If you are sincere and steady, you will gradually learn all this.
Sermon

A sermon by the church pastor or other ministers takes much of the meeting’s time. A sermon is ministering with the Word. From it, we get knowledge, revelations that help us solve our problems, and a deeper understanding of God. Having a notepad to write down passages from the Scripture and insights you liked is helpful. Then, you will be able to share the sermon with others more accurately.
Prayer

At the church, people pray a lot. Prayer is a conversation with God. There are different kinds of prayer. Some prayers glorify God. In others, we present our needs to God or pray for the needs of other people.
Special ministries
There are also special ministries at the church, such as various announcements, testimonies, offerings (we will talk about them during the next lesson), etc.
May all of this serve our growth.

One newly converted Christian told me, «I agree to serve God, but I do not agree with how church meetings are conducted. Some people pray too loud, and some sing too joyfully. It should be quiet and calm». It reminded me of one brother, a preacher, who is with the Lord now. He loved to sing very much. He sang with the church, with the choir, and with the soloists. It would have been fine, but he had a loud, raspy voice and was completely tone-deaf. If someone told him, «Why do you sing? You impede everyone», he would answer, «God has many birds, there are nightingales and crows, and God allows each one of them to sing according to its abilities.» He did not stop to praise God with his raspy voice until he died! Every person has the right to praise God and pray the way God reveals to them. If you are a quiet person, pray quietly. If you like loudness, pray loudly.
Every person has the right to serve God in accordance with their personality. The church is for everyone, young and old. Respect and love one another because we all are God’s family.
For many, this is the most challenging issue in serving God. Many people are ready to give their lives for God but do not want to give a single coin.

Once, a preaching teacher from the US visited my home. He was of Italian descent. He told me a story. In some old Italian churches, people do not like to listen to sermons about tithe, while the same cannot be said about American churches (it is no surprise that the Italian lira was devalued so many times). One pastor from Italy invited him to speak at his church and warned him that the people would not accept a sermon about tithe. But God inspired him to speak specifically about tithe! He resisted, but God’s Spirit insisted, and he gave up. There was an ominous silence during the sermon. Many people demonstratively left the meeting at the end. No one shook this brother’s hand. He was shocked. What a shame!

A few years later, he visited that church again. A young man came to him and invited him to his home for lunch. When they arrived, he was surprised to see a beautiful house. He was shown into the garage and saw two beautiful cars there. The young man asked him, «Do you remember your sermon about tithe?» «Oh, yes!» he answered, «it was the most terrible sermon in my life». «No,» the young man said, «it was the best sermon. I had about $20 with me on that day. God told me to tithe and continue to do so in the future. I resisted, but I did it. One week later, God helped me open my own business, and I made a lot of money in two years. What you see now is only a small part of what I own. I invited you to my home to thank you for your sermon».
I do not want you to take this story as agitation.

Why do we tithe
(give ten percent of our income)?

1) Because God said so in the Bible.
2) To protect ourselves from ruin and to receive financial blessings.
3) To prove our faithfulness to God with actions;
4) To support the needs of the church in preaching the Gospel.
5) It is God’s part in the financial sphere.
Where does the tithe go?

1) To cover rent and all administrative expenses, including construction and repair of the church building.
2) To support the ministers and administrative staff working in the church full-time.
3) To reach the world with the Gospel (people needing help, missionaries, and evangelization).
4) To help members of the church who are in need.

As a church pastor, I want to tell you that I have nothing to do with money. The accounting office takes care of money in the church, and their accounting is strict. The office answers to the bank, tax inspection, and the church Counting Board.
God does not need tithe, and the pastor does not need tithe. We need it for God to bless us!
Also, do not forget that this is all done voluntarily, and you decide whether to give or not.
May the Lord bless you!
Now, we will talk about something you already know a little about. The topic of today’s lesson is Mentorship.
First, let us define the terms: you are the one being mentored, and the one mentoring you is the mentor.
Who is a mentor?

First and foremost, they are your friend who came to the Lord earlier than you. A mentor is not a teacher or a pastor but your friend. A mentor listens more than they teach; they simply help you know Jesus better.

Once, I was watching alpinists on TV. They were linked to each other with ropes. After one of them climbed a little, he helped the next climber and then the next one. If someone stumbled, everybody held him. They climbed to the top together and celebrated their victory together. If an accident happens, they will deal with it together.
The best definition of mentorship is «friendship», as it is, indeed, pure Christian friendship.

I want to note that a mentor has no right to decide for you. A mentor tells you about different solutions to difficult situations, but you have to make your own decisions. You are an individual and the right to make decisions belongs to you.
I want to ask you to respect your mentor and pray for them. Your mentor is an ordinary human who willingly sacrifices time and effort for your salvation.

There is the «Law of Generations». We cannot return all the love, patience, money, sleepless nights, premature wrinkles, and sometimes even their lives to our parents, who devoted themselves to us. We must give it to our children! They give it to their children, and life on Earth continues.

You can not fully return your mentor’s help. There is only one way: to complete the Mentorship and become a mentor yourself! «But I know so little!» you may say. Remember, a mentor is not a teacher, but a friend who helps one walk along the way (using the book you are reading). And I hope you know what it means to be a friend

Mentorship can also take place in groups of 5 to 25 people. In such a case, the mentor is an experienced minister or a pastor. It resembles a family with many children who all learn from their parents
In such a case, you can bring your friends to these classes, complete lessons with them, and help them grow.
I would like to ask you something: prepare a surprise for your mentor. Pray about it and ask God for wisdom. Show your mentor that you love and value them and their help.
Today, we have a new subject: prayer. What is prayer?

Prayer is a conversation with God. When I was a child, I did not like to pray because I did not understand it. I thought it was some ritual where one has to speak odd religious words at a specific time and place.
I thank God that He revealed the true meaning and beauty of prayer to me. Now, prayer is my favorite activity, and it is beautiful.
Once, the disciples of Jesus came to him and asked, «Teach us how to pray.»

Let us define some
basic principles of prayer

1. Prayer is personal and individual.
2. You need to learn how to pray.
3. God answers prayers!
Let us review these three principles one by one.

1. Prayer (conversation) should be personal and come from the bottom of your heart. You can not copy prayer. Prayer should be absolutely genuine because God knows all our thoughts. God will not accept an embellished prayer that does not come from the bottom of one’s heart. You need to pray as you talk with someone you love (your mother, father, husband, or wife). You need to open your heart in prayer and hide nothing. God will hear such a prayer!

2. The disciples of Jesus learned how to pray, and we have to learn it too. How could we learn to pray? Practice prayer daily, learn from your mentor or the pastor of your home church, and learn from the Bible and other useful books. SINCERITY, PERSEVERANCE, AND TIME WILL CERTAINLY PRODUCE A GOOD RESULT!

3. The most important thing is that prayer is not a ritual. God participates in prayer and answers them. The Bible teaches us that we can ask God for anything according to his will, and he shall give it to us. Wow! Do you know where prayer originated from? It came from the Garden of Eden, where God talked with people face-to-face before the Fall. It was the first prayer!
Prayer is a conversation between a person and God!
Do not forget that although you are the one who needs prayer, God also wants to speak with you, just like a parent enjoys a conversation with their child.

Prayer is:
DEPTH of communication
LEVEL of the relationship
POWER of gratitude
In this passage, Apostle Paul says that we have to devote ourselves to prayer watchfully.
How long do we need to pray, and when?
1. Devote your best time to prayer. Do not follow the principle: «I give God what I don’t need.»
2. Train yourself to be steady and value prayer above all else in the world. It is a holy and inviolable time
How to pray every day?
1. Morning prayer. After you finish your morning routines, pray a prayer of blessing for the day before you go to work.
2. Before each meal. A short prayer of blessing for the food.
3. Evening prayer. As a family, we thank God for the day and ask for His blessing on the night.
4. During the day. Requests and gratitude regarding various circumstances.
«But I have so little time,» you may say, «There is no comfortable place, and there are unbelievers all around me. What to do?»

Once, I was teaching my children to tidy up their room. The most important thing is to put everything in its place. If toys, clothes, and books are piled up in the middle of the room, it is not possible to find anything, and there is always a lack of space. Therefore, you need to put away things that you do not need. Recently, we cleaned our house and collected half a bag of useless things! We discovered so much free space!
Take a look at your time and think about how you spend it. Put everything in its place. Every task and activity should have its time and place.

We just read «Our Father,» the most beautiful prayer. We can organize our prayer following the model of this prayer. I can also share my experience in prayer with you. For me, my morning prayer is the most important one. Let us take a look:
How to learn to pray practically?
1. Write down the six points mentioned above on a separate sheet of paper or in your prayer journal.
2. Write down your needs.
3. Determine a period of time for every point. You can start with one minute for each point (it will add up to 6 minutes total)
4. Take your watch with you and practice praying for one minute on each point until it becomes easy for you to pray.
5. After a month (can be earlier or later), add one more minute for each point, and so on and so forth.
I would like to share with you a principle that is the most significant accomplishment of my whole life.
If you learn to pray, you will learn how to do anything. If you do not learn to pray, you will never learn anything.

Prayer is your connection with God, a contact with him, and a channel through which he gives us power, the power that can change everything. Prayer is everything. It is not possible for you to love God and not love prayer.

In the end, I will say this: «The devil will find a hundred reasons to stop you from praying. You need to fight yourself, your laziness, time, and circumstances for your prayer. If you put God and prayer first, you will win; if not, you will lose. In this case, the winnings are your life.»
This passage says that we are to pray with all kinds of prayers. During the previous lesson, we considered personal daily prayer, which is the most important one. What are the other types of prayer?
1. Church-wide prayer.

In a church or a home church, all people pray together. What do we need to pray for? A pastor or another minister invites us to pray for some need or cause. Be attentive and follow the service. Such prayers lead to great results, so participate in them with joy.
2. Prayer for the Sunday service.

There are different methods for this kind of prayer. Sometimes, a particular time can be set, for instance, on Saturdays from 10 to 11 PM. During this time, the whole church should pray. Within each home church, this hour is divided into 10 to 15-minute intervals, and 2 or 3 people are appointed for each interval. This way, the entire church is praying. There are other methods for this prayer: a 24-hour prayer, which starts on Saturday noon and continues until the service begins, praying one hour before the service, etc.
3. Church-wide fasting and prayer.

Your home church is assigned one day each month. Strategic needs are set. For example, it can be a church building construction project, evangelism ministry in a particular city, etc. I would like to mention that a fast (abstention from food) only matters if accompanied by prayer. Without prayer, you are just starving yourself. How do you organize fasting and prayer? The fasting begins with the whole home church or 2 to 3 people discussing the needs and praying for them for 20 to 30 minutes. During the day, every home church member prays for those needs for 3 to 5 minutes at the start of every hour. The fasting and prayer ends with the entire home church giving thanks.
4. Prayer before the meal.
It is a very short prayer, for example, «Dear Jesus, we thank you for this food and ask you to bless it. Amen».
5. Prayer in various circumstances.
(At work, in a car, in any situation).
When a difficult problem arises, you can pray, «Heavenly Father, help me. I ask you in the name of Jesus Christ».
If the devil attacks and tempts you, pray: «Dear Jesus, I can do nothing without you, but you are able. devil, go away in the name of Jesus!»
Visible divine protection, pray: «Father, I thank you for your help…»
6. There are also other kinds of prayers; one of them is prayer in the Holy Spirit. We’ll talk about it later.
Say «amen» at the end of every prayer. This word means «I agree, I confirm, it is true.»
I have given you these prayers as examples. So go and fill your life with prayer, and your life will be filled with God!
For a long time, I could not understand why Jesus had performed so many miracles, why Apostles Paul and Peter performed them, but I can not.

Then, I realized that no one can perform miracles except God. Prayer is a thin channel by which God’s power is given to a human, and this power performs miracles! If there is no channel or the channel is blocked, there is no power. If the channel is strong and steady, there is a lot of power.
Therefore, how could Jesus perform so many miracles and signs? He prayed a lot. If even Jesus needed prayer, then so do we!
Healing the sick, blind, and deaf, calming the storm, multiplying the bread, and resurrecting the dead are the results of prayer!

When I was 17, I started experiencing severe pains in my stomach. I was not able to eat anything because food caused extreme pain. I was examined and treated for a long time. My conditions grew worse, and I became as thin as a rake. I was deferred from military service due to my health condition. All I could eat was light soup.

One night, I sat in my room, crying. I ate a small piece of meat and was paying dearly for it. Suddenly, I remembered prayer. I kneeled and asked God to heal me. In my spirit, God revealed to me that I need to believe, and I said, «Lord, I believe that You are healing me.» I did not feel anything special at the moment, but I believed that my prayer was heard. I took a piece of meat and began to eat it, washing it down with water. It was extremely dangerous, but I believed. There was no pain! Nothing bad happened!
Sometime later, I went to take another examination and treatment. The doctor who examined me was astonished! He said, exactly: «What a fool has diagnosed you with this? You are 100% healthy.»
That is what prayer can do.
Let us summarize what we learned about prayer:
1. Prayer to God should be the highest priority.
2. When you pray, you must believe and forgive everyone.
3. If you pray constantly, you will learn how much you need to pray for a particular need and when your prayer is heard.
God will answer your prayers, too! Love prayer and pray. When the world-renowned evangelist Billy Graham was asked about the secret of his success, he said:
«There are three secrets to my ministry.

THE FIRST ONE IS PRAYER,
THE SECOND IS PRAYER,
THE THIRD IS PRAYER.»
I want to remind you that even Jesus needed prayer. Whoever you are, there is only one channel between Heaven and Earth: PRAYER.

weeks.title: The most interesting and useful book

content.data: How fast time flies! We are now in Week 6 of our lessons. I hope you became friends with your mentor and grew spiritually. This week, we will study the Bible, which is a book that is read more than any other book in the world.

We just read the words of Jesus. To live physically, we need bread (food), and to live spiritually, we need the Word of God (the Bible). Not all countries in the world have the same «bread.» In China, it is rice. In some countries, it is biscuits. In other ones, it may be fish, vegetables, or fruits. Bread is the most important and essential product. In Ukraine, for example, potatoes can also be considered «bread».

The Bible contains many books and a great number of different stories and events. As a whole, it has been the spiritual bread for all people for thousands of years. There are a lot of good and important books, but most of them quickly get old and fade into obscurity along with their authors.
«What about the classics–you may ask–the masterpieces of world culture, textbooks, and fiction?» Well, let us put everything in its place.
1. There is the bread in the first place: the Word of God, the Bible
2. There are good dietary supplements. They are not essential but useful: good books.

3. There is corrupted and poisonous food. These are books (movies, music), social networks, and YouTube channels that contain demonism (fortune-telling, hypnosis, magic, Eastern religions), pornography, sadism, horror, etc.

Will it not get boring to always read the Bible? Several years ago, when I was very hungry, I ate too much halva. But I have never overeaten bread. One can eat too much chocolate or jam, but not too much bread!

Almost every day, we dispose of garbage from our kitchen. My wife is always careful so that nothing harmful will get into our food. Throw away all spiritual garbage and waste so that your life will not reek. Check your books and videos. Throw out, burn, and delete all the trash! Remember that you can only throw away things that belong to you. If something is not yours, discuss it with the owner.

One more thing: you can not fill yourself with a lifetime of bread at once. You need to eat something every day. The same is true about reading the Bible. I have read the Bible cover to cover many times. I still read it daily, and the Word of God is always new, pleasant, and fresh to me. Love the Bible and read it!

lessons.title: A little bit about the Bible

content.data: Many authors wrote the Bible, but they all wrote under the dictation of the Holy Spirit. The Bible reflects God. In the Gospel of John, it is written that the Word (Bible) is the essence of Jesus Christ. How many Bibles are there? There is only one Bible. There are many translations into different languages. But there is only one Bible. There is no Catholic, Orthodox, or Baptist Bible. There is the Bible.
The Bible consists of 66 books and is divided into two parts:

1. The Old Testament (39 books)
2. The New Testament – the Gospel (27 books)
There might be various appendixes at the end of a Bible: commentaries, maps, and historical data. They are helpful, but they are not a part of the Bible.
Every book in the Bible is divided into chapters, and chapters are divided into verses. When the Scripture is quoted, the names of the books are often shortened:
For example, 1 Cor. 3:2 means the First Epistle of the Apostle Paul to Corinthians, Chapter 3, verse 2.

The first five books of the Bible make up the Old Covenant Laws. We do not live according to the Law but according to the Gospel. Jesus Christ fulfilled the Law in its entirety and gave us the Gospel. Today, the Old Testament sets an example for us, while the New Testament is the manual for our lives. The news about salvation for humanity through Jesus Christ is a recurring narrative in the Bible.

Sometimes, when people read the Bible, they ask, «Why are there cruel episodes of war or bad things in the lives of some people in the Bible?» The Word of God contains the history of humanity with all its sins and vices. The Bible shows everything truthfully and without embellishment.
Here is a brief summary of the Bible:

God created the world, and it was good. People disobeyed God and sinned. The Lord tried to bring humankind back to life using various methods. He revealed forgiveness through animal sacrifice to people. Many prophets were sent, but humanity delved deeper and deeper into sin. By God’s grace, Jesus Christ was born. He gave His life for people’s sins and returned to the Father. The Holy Spirit was sent to aid the Church, and now, He is guiding the Church. Jesus Christ will come for a second time to take His Church, and the rest of the world will be judged according to their deeds.

THE BOOK OF LIFE
THE BIBLE IS – THE BOOK ABOUT LIFE
THE BOOK FOR LIFE
The Bible contains a multitude of treasures. How to extract them? I’ll share three secrets with you:
1st secret

You need to read the Bible, read it routinely and daily. I advise you to start by reading one or several chapters from the New Testament a day. Bread gives you strength for a day, but the next day, it weakens. The same is true with the Bible. Every day needs its own revelation from the Word.
2nd secret
Read with prayer. Ask God for the ability to understand what you are reading. Ask for wisdom and special revelations from the Bible. Do not forget to thank God for His Word.
3rd secret

After you read the Bible, apply the Word in your life. Remember, even if you learn all the wisdom of God and know all the mysteries of the world but do not apply any of it in your life, it is all in vain.

Let us open Ephesians 2:8-9. It says, «For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith – and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God – not by works, so that no one can boast.» You can also read it like this, «For it is by grace I have been saved, through faith – and this is not from myself, it is the gift of God – not by works, so that I can not boast.»
I also read the Bible when I pray. I thank God and praise Him, and then I read 5-10 verses from the book of Psalms aloud. The Word guides my prayer in the right direction.
You can also study the Bible. What does it say about love, faith, eternal life, etc?

A book that lists words from the Bible in alphabetical order is a very helpful tool for quickly searching for a needed passage. There are also excellent dictionaries, reference books, and commentaries. But the Bible is the most important.

You can also get a special notebook in which you will write down the revelations you receive when you read the Bible. If you do not understand a passage, ask your mentor or the pastor of your home church. Share your revelations from the Word with your mentor and during your home church meetings.
I want to give you three pieces of advice to understand the Bible:

1. READ!
2. READ!
3. READ!

The Bible has many meanings and applications. We just read that the Word of God is like a sword. Why do we need a sword? We need it to attack. A shield is for defense. When Jesus was tempted in the desert, he overcame the devil by simply quoting the Bible. It is a spiritual sword.
How to practically apply the Word of God?
1. Memorize the most important verses from the Bible. You may need them at any moment.
2. Quote verses aloud during moments of temptation. The devil is afraid of the Word and your faith in it.
3. Think and dream in accordance with the Word of God. The power of the Word should renew your mind.

A sister from our church was greatly suffering from the spirit of fear. She was afraid of everything and everywhere. The fear tormented her day and night. As a result, she could not remain in her apartment alone, even during the day. There were many prayers and conversations, but nothing helped. The spirit of fear enslaved her mind. But then, God enlightened her mind through the Word, and she understood that there is no fear in God's perfect love. This understanding of His Word enlightened her mind, and she was completely free from fear.
Some practical tips on the application of God’s Word:

1. In times of temptation (fear, depression, bad news, despair, «nobody loves me,» «no one needs me,» etc.), apply James 4:7, «Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you». To submit means to listen, to resist means not to listen. Say, «Lord, I obey You. You have the power. I can do nothing, but You can do everything. Devil (fear, depression, etc.), be gone in the name of Jesus!» Repeat this until the temptation will go away.

2. When disappointed in faith («God does not hear me,» «I am not saved,» «God will never forgive me,» etc.), quote Romans 8:38-39. Instead of the words «us» and «our,» use the words «me» and «my.» Cite this passage until complete victory.

3. In times of sickness (prayer for the sick, symptoms of an illness, chronic diseases, etc.), quote 1 Peter 2:24. Instead of the words «our,» «we,» and «you,» use the words «my» and «I». It is very important to proclaim these words with faith because it is impossible to please God without faith.
We have already learned many new things. We understood and discovered a lot. But there is something without which all of it is in vain, and it is faith. Where does faith come from?
Read Rom. 10:17 and fill in the missing words:
Faith comes when we perceive (hear) the Word of God. Faith is a condition without which God does not accept us or our prayers.
Why do we need faith?
1. To receive forgiveness for our sins, we need prayer with confession + faith.
2. To have the strength to overcome sin, we need to profess the power of the Blood of Jesus + our faith.
3. To receive healing from illness, we need prayer according to the Word + faith.
4. To receive the ability to live by the Word (righteousness), we need the profession and acceptance of the righteousness of Jesus + faith.
Faith is of immense importance. It is what turns theory into practice. The Bible says that the righteous shall live by faith.
Where does faith come from? It comes from the Word of God. We can provisionally divide God’s Word into two parts:
«Rhema» is what we hear (perceive);
«Logos» is what we read (text);
Faith comes from «rhema.» «Rhema» comes from «logos.»
In all your prayers, whatever you ask, you need to believe, believe, and believe. But it should be based on the Word only! True faith comes from the Word of God.

There is a proverb about an old woman. In the Bible, she read that if a believer tells a mountain, «Go, throw yourself into the sea,» it will be done. A mountain in front of her house bothered her very much. She prayed all night for the mountain to disappear. When she looked through the window in the morning, she saw that it was still there. She said, «I knew it. It will never move.»
One man said: «I believe in «after,» not «before.» In reality, «after» is knowledge, and «before» is faith.
It is not enough to read the Bible. You need to «hear.» And you can only «hear» if you read with prayer and a sincere and open heart.

This week, we will take a spiritual X-ray. It is easy to see flaws in others and correct someone else, but it is very difficult to see faults in yourself and deal with them. We just read about unforgiveness. Here is a dependency that Jesus personally showed us (fill in the missing words from Matthew 6:14-15):
Unforgiveness is when we cannot forget something bad someone has done to us.
Bitterness is our attitude toward a person whom we cannot forgive.
Unforgiveness is related to a particular event, and bitterness is an attitude that has developed as a result of unforgiveness.
These two sins enslave and entangle people.

If a person does not forgive, that person lives in constant dependence on the offender. Break these chains of unforgiveness in the name of Jesus! Jesus gives you the power to forgive because He forgives you.

What does it mean to forgive? It means to erase the event from your memory, stop bringing it up, and love your offender! It can be accomplished only through prayer and faith in the power of the Blood of Jesus. You can not do it yourself. Do not even try. Jesus will help you because He forgives and gives you the power to forgive.

What else does our spiritual X-ray show? Addictions are often deeply entrenched in the corners of our hearts. What are they? Things that influence, direct, and control our lives. An addiction has a strong, enthralling attraction that our mind is unable to control. This attraction is often much more powerful than our willpower.
A stronghold is something that sits like a thorn in our minds and hinders normal Christian life.

Throughout our entire lives, we carry all our -bitterness, fear, and addictions with us. Years go -by, and this burden gets very heavy. So many -people have collapsed under the pressure of their -burden and never set themselves free. Jesus -wants to set you free! You do not have to carry all -this garbage with you! Pray the prayer of -repentance with your mentor, believing in the -power of the Blood of Jesus, which sets you free.

Once, a young woman came to me and said that she was addicted to theft. She would frequently take things that did not belong to her, not shying away from taking money. This addiction impoverished her. The more she stole, the poorer she became. We prayed the prayer of repentance together. Soon after, she got a good job, and her life changed completely.
In John 8:32, the Bible says: «Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free», adding in verse 36: «So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.»
Jesus Christ can set you free through His Word. Receive this freedom with faith. Be free!

Today, the world is filled with occultism more than ever before. The time of cartoons about rabbits and squirrels is gone. Movies about moral values are leaving the stage. They are being replaced with spirits, djinns, vampires, monsters, and other evil. In almost every newspaper, there is a horoscope that diminishes humans, equating them to a «pig,» «goat,» «lobster,» and other reptiles and hooved ones.
Occultism is servitude to demons (servants of satan) in any area of life.

There is a constant flow of TV, newspaper, and radio advertisements about «miracle makers» who say that they can heal any disease, alcoholism, and smoking in 5 minutes. You often find adverts like this one on streetlights:

Offices of hypnotizing doctors appeared with promises of pain-free surgeries. Recently, a satanist quack promised to fly to outer space and make people’s hands and legs grow from out there. Satan knows that his end is near, so he is pushing his hellish sludge everywhere.

Let us read about what will happen to those involved in occultism or in contact with those who are. Rv. 21:8 says, «...those who practice magic arts, the idolaters and all liars—they will be consigned to the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death.»
Curses are diseases, calamities, problems, or death wished upon people by other people. Especially relatives or sorcerers.

What do you imagine when you hear the word «idol»? The dictionary says an idol is a statue or object worshipped like a deity. The first of the Ten Commandments says, «You shall have no other gods before me. You shall not make for yourself an image in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below. You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me…» (Exodus, 20:3-5).

Therefore, God has to be in the first place. He will never relinquish His first place or agree to be second. An idol is something that is in the first place in your life. An idol can be your child, job, car, house, garden, TV, hobby, life goal, money, religion, drugs, alcohol, illegal sexual relationships, etc. An idol is an addiction, and the person becomes its slave. An idol always destroys a person’s life because it gets the first place (authority).

Once, a friend of mine decided to get married. We were happy for him, but with time, we noticed that his love was strange. He told everyone that he loved his wife more than life and that if she died, he would die, too. Then came wild jealousy. He would do everything to not let anyone near her. For this man, his wife gradually became an idol. He became a slave to his wife. She noticed his attitude and began manipulating him. This man took anything his wife did as divine. Her body, voice, and skills became the meaning of his life. Once, they quarreled. He lost control, and his wife called the police. Suddenly, he realized she was not a goddess but a woman with flaws. It was a severe shock for him, and he ended up in a mental hospital. What a shameful end of his love for the wife-idol. Every idol will lead to a similar result because idols destroy our lives.

For our entire lives, we are trying to make other people love us. We often build our lives based on what relatives, fashion, or idols say. In Eph. 2:1, we read that all people live by either God’s will or the devil’s. You may say, «I have never obeyed the devil.» Maybe, but this world’s system of moral values is from the devil. What is a system of moral values? It is a system that defines what is good and what is bad. You must desire to change this devilish worldly system for God’s system. This is so important! Today, it has become the norm to swear at each other. People openly boast about betraying each other or their sexual depravities. People have no shame in the way they dress; nudist beaches are open; children are sold alcohol and cigarettes; multiple websites offer pornography; drugs have become a fashion. Such is the system of moral values that is dictated to this world by the devil!
But God defined His system of moral values, which gives life.
A person’s moral qualities were always highly valued, but among them, faithfulness was especially appreciated. That’s why the name of Judas became eponymous with people’s contempt for betrayal.
The opposite of faithfulness is self-interest (if it benefits me, I do it, and if it doesn’t, I don’t).

Why is everything so serious? The Son of God paid for our salvation with His Blood, suffering, and life. Believing in Jesus is not about feelings or money. It is far more serious, an issue of life and death: I will either live forever with Jesus or suffer forever with the devil. The Bible says, «there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.» Just like heaven, hell will never end. It is eternal. One preacher said, «If once every million years an eagle would have flown from the Moon to the Earth, picked up a grain of sand, and flown back, then by the time he would have moved our entire planet, eternity would have just begun.» Then what is the meaning of our life that lasts 70 or 100 years? This is why Jesus valued the salvation of people so much.
When we make any commercial deal (it may be the purchase of bread, a car, or a house), there are three things present:
When we accept the gift of eternal salvation from sin and punishment for sin, we also make these three steps:
1. We receive salvation by faith in Jesus Christ;
2. We make an agreement with God about salvation and faithfulness (water baptism);
3. Christ pays for our salvation Himself and gives it to us already paid for.

All over the world, serious deals are based on contracts. If a young man tells his girlfriend he loves her but refuses to marry her, he is a liar and traitor. His mind is far from love. He wants to use the girl to satisfy his lust on an animalistic level. True love is not afraid of a marriage certificate.

I knew a person who paid a high price for neglecting contracts. His relative came to this man and borrowed a significant amount of money for a short term. A while later, the man called his relative and said it was time to return the money. He pretended he did not take anything from him and had no idea what he was talking about. A contract is a very serious thing, especially if it has to do with life and death! God wants to have a serious, wonderful, and eternal relationship with you!

What is water baptism? The Greek word «baptismos» means «submersion.» When a person made a serious decision to become a Christian, they would stand in water before witnesses and promise to serve God. A church minister would then immerse this person into the water, symbolizing the death of their old sinful life and resurrection for a new life.
Why do we need to receive water baptism?
1. Because it is the only way to be saved (Mk. 16:16
2. Because Jesus Christ received water baptism (Mk. 1:9)
3. Because water baptism is an eternal agreement with God (Rom. 5:1)
Who can receive water baptism?
1. Any person who accepted Jesus as their Lord and repented of their sins.
2. The age of a person who can receive water baptism is determined by their ability to make decisions. Therefore, infants can not be baptized.
3. «If you believe with all your heart, you may.» the Bible says.

But when does a person need to be baptized?The next day after repentance or one year later?Does it have to happen only when one isspiritually mature and good? You need to receivewater baptism when you made a firm decision tofollow Christ and repented from your sins. Myfather was baptized when he was 15. I receivedwater baptism at 19 and my daughter when shewas 13. It needs to be your faith and decision.

Water baptism is always a celebration. The people who are being baptized wear white clothing and look like angels. God performs many miracles during water baptisms: people are baptized with the Holy Spirit, healed from illnesses, and released from oppression.
Millions of people were baptized in water, including Jesus Christ, the Apostles, Volodymyr the Great, our fathers and grandfathers. The list goes on and on.

I’d like to note that you need to receive water baptism not after you become good but when you want to become good. Water baptism was not always as easy to obtain as it is today. There were times when people were fined, imprisoned, or even killed for it. But no one could stop people's unwavering desire for a serious and eternal relationship with God built on trust. After baptism, you belong entirely to God and have His protection, grace, and love.

The Bible tells us about one more baptism: baptism with the Holy Spirit, and it is one of the most wonderful experiences in a person’s life. A special sign that accompanies baptism with the Holy Spirit is speaking in tongues. People respond to the baptism in different ways: some cry, some sing, and some express great joy. Sometimes, people shake because of the overflowing emotions, but these are secondary things.
There are two key factors in baptism with the Holy Spirit:
1. We receive the supernatural power to testify about Jesus Christ.
2. We receive special gifts of the Spirit: knowledge, tongues, healings, ministry, etc.
Figuratively, it can be said that water baptism makes us soldiers of Christ, and spiritual baptism equips us for battle.
How to receive baptism with the Holy Spirit? Three steps to baptism with the Holy Spirit:
1. Thirst. The Bible says, «Let anyone who is thirsty come to me and drink.» You need to have a firm desire for the Holy Spirit.
2. Request. Ask in prayer because the Bible says, «Ask and it will be given to you…»
3. Faith. Baptism belongs to all Christians. God gives us the Holy Spirit not according to our deeds but as a gift. Receive the Holy Spirit!

I want to remind you not to control the process of the baptism with your mind. We must completely give our will, emotions, and lips to the Holy Spirit. If there is control, there will be no baptism. Only faith is needed!

As a Christian, I prayed about baptism with the Holy Spirit for a long time. I often gave way to despair, thinking I was not worthy. Once, when I was praying, I told God, «I wish I could speak in tongues.» God replied, «Speak then, you keep asking all the time and do not give any room to me, stop and speak». Prayer began to flow from my heart like a river, and there was great joy. Once you are baptized, be filled with the Spirit every day, be eager for the Spirit, develop your relationship with the Spirit, and rivers of living water will flow from you.
If God baptized you with the Holy Spirit, you have great potential!
First, what is a gift?
