Literally, it is a present with which we receive a supernatural ability for one or several types of ministries to other people in the home church (church). There are many gifts, but the main ones are listed in 1 Corinthians 12:8-10:

- message of wisdom
- gifts of healing
- message of knowledge
- miraculous powers
- faith
- prophesy
- speaking in different kinds of tongues
- interpretation of tongues
Second, how to receive a gift?

When the Holy Spirit comes upon us, the doors to gifts open before us. First, we need to be filled with the Spirit every day. Second, we need to obey God. Third, we need to believe. A gift comes progressively and needs to be developed. I want to mention that God gives us gifts Himself. We do not choose them. Do not hurry to have a gift of healing or miraculous powers. God knows the gift through which our personality will be most fruitful.
Third, where and how to use the gifts?

1. Gifts need to be used to serve other people, first and foremost, in your home church.
2. Gifts shall be used only for the improvement of the church, not for its destruction.
3. Love is the driving force behind every gift. If you are driven by anything else (proving that you’re right, humiliating someone, justifying yourself), it is not from the Lord.
I want to tell you a story about how multi-faceted the gifts of the Spirit are in action.

Once, I attended a church service with our evangelism group. There was a man whose mother was very ill, and we were invited to come and pray for her. When we came into their home, we learned that she had been in bed for three days and suffered from severe headaches and heart pains. She could not get up from her bed and suffered greatly, even though an ambulance had already come to her and tried to help her as much as they could. Her husband was a deacon at a local church. We began to pray together. After a short prayer, she said her headache stopped, but her heart pains continued. She felt exhausted. Suddenly, I received a message of knowledge and said, «Her husband must pray for her.» My brothers confirmed it, as they received a similar message. We asked her husband to pray. At first, he refused, but we insisted, and he put his hands on her. Immediately, something happened, and they began to cry. Several minutes later, she was completely healthy! I did not understand what happened, but then their son, who invited us, explained that his parents quarreled bitterly, and she became very ill as a result. The moment her husband laid his hands on her, they were reconciled, and healing came to her. How wonderful is our God! Pray and be eager to have the Holy Spirit and His gifts!

In any university, college, or school, there are exams that evaluate our knowledge and abilities. Luke writes that after the water baptism and the baptism with the Holy Spirit, the Spirit led Jesus to the wilderness to be tempted (tested).
Temptation is a circumstance, problem, or attack of the devil that suddenly befalls us and our lives to test our faith and faithfulness to God.

No one graduates without exams, and there are plenty of exams during the studying itself. God can not entrust something important to us if he does not see our faithfulness. You will face tests on your journey! Satan attacks people with extraordinary ferocity before and after baptism. Problems appear at work and in the family. Suddenly, someone gets sick, or a relative visits or invites you. And all this happens precisely at the time of baptism!
Jesus Christ fought temptations with God’s pure Word. Use this method, too! Do not argue, complain, or try to prove anything. Simply proclaim God’s Word (look at Lesson 4 of Week 5).
I want to give you some helpful advice on how to fight temptation:

1. Do not complain. Complaining is one of the most terrible sins.
2. Do not despair. A test is temporary.
3. Be steadfast and faithful because that’s what God wants to see in you.
4. Share your situation with your mentor and in your home church. It is easier to overcome problems together!
5. If you want temptation to be over quickly, make a firm decision to remain faithful. Satan will see it and retreat, understanding that he can do nothing to you.

Once, my younger son fell and broke a finger. Then, I had to take my wife to the hospital because her pregnancy was threatened, and on our way to the hospital, my car broke down. Satan sent me thoughts: «Where is your God?

Why do such things happen to a pastor? God does not hear you. No one needs you». I prayed and stood firm in my trust in the Lord. The finger was miraculously healed, a healthy and beautiful son was born, and God gave me an opportunity to buy another car.
Be firm, and remember that the Lord will give you strength to overcome all temptations!

weeks.title: A room of fellowship with God

content.data: When Jesus was on Earth, He said He is the Shepherd, and His sheep hear and know His voice. With time, people changed this truth and started to babble about «holy» priests and «sinful» parishioners. Many began to think they had no right to speak with God because this right belonged exclusively to priests. Many myths about mediators and intercessors between God and people were created. But the Bible says we have only one Mediator and Intercessor, Jesus Christ! (1 Tim. 2:5) Jesus also said we became His children. For example, there are no mediators between me and my children. I speak with them myself and receive great joy from it.
What does one need to hear God’s voice?
1. to accept Jesus Christ as your Lord (King, Father, Master).
2. to receive forgiveness by faith through the Blood of Jesus Christ.
3. to receive baptism and be filled with the Holy Spirit.
4. to be born again (change one’s worldly lifestyle).
5. to have a consistent prayer life.
I must tell you that you have already heard God’s voice when God encouraged you to repent.
Let us look at three questions together:
First, why do I need to hear God’s voice?

Unequivocally, to fulfill His will. Through our relationship with Him, we receive comfort, encouragement, and direction for the work in His field. If you want to communicate with God for the sake of entertainment or out of curiosity, it will not work.
Second: what in me communicates with God?

When God comes into our hearts, our spirit is renewed, and it is through the spirit that felfellowship with God takes place. Our soul (mind, will, memory, emotions) is directly connected to the spirit. Thus, we can respond to God through enlightenment (memory), feelings (joy, peace), will (desire), or mind (clear thoughts inside us).
Third: when can God speak to us?
I want to assure you that God speaks to us all the time, 24/7. The real question is, when are we listening to Him?

I want to remind you again of the seriousness of a relationship with God. After frequently talking with people and looking at their problems, I discovered one thing many have in common: they do not have a special time and place for fellowship with God. Please pay attention to the following paragraphs! Many say they pray at the train station, others during their commute, and others whenever they have an opportunity. Some bold people say, «I pray all the time, all day, this is why I don’t have a special time and place.» Perhaps it is true, but in reality, they never pray.

You must have your own «fellowship room» with God. It does not necessarily have to be an actual room. Jesus prayed in a garden, on a hill, in a desert, and almost always at night. You can also have such a place or places (room, park, bathroom, forest, etc). I want to emphasize that time and place are not the key factors. What is essential is secrecy and regularity. Nothing and no one should hinder you. In Matthew 6:6, Jesus said we must talk with the Father in secret. Not only should no one hinder you, but you should also not be a hindrance to others. I want to warn wives and husbands: do not go to prayer right after your spouse comes from work or when you are going to sleep. God does not want to steal time from your husband, wife, or your boss at work. God wants to have His personal time with you. Find it, plan your sleep, rest, and time when you watch TV.

When I decided to speak with God daily, an attack of the devil befell me. As soon as I entered the room, a neighbor would come to ask for a shovel, guests would arrive, or some urgent business would come up. Then, my wife and I decided that she would not call for me unless I came out myself. All temptations stopped right away.

I, along with some other pastors from Ukraine, once had the honor of attending a reception of the Prime Minister of Norway. We came to the palace right on time. We passed the guards and entered a beautiful hall. The meeting lasted for about an hour and ended with a joint pray. I always greatly appreciated this meeting, as I understood that such a busy and important person gave us attention. But how much more do we need to value the meeting with the King of Kings, Lord of Lords, the Master of the Universe! Your prayers will pass through the ranks of angels, and you will have the great honor of speaking with the Creator of Heaven and Earth!
A room of fellowship with God is a lifestyle; it is a center and a foundation from which your new life begins.
The center has to be at the center!
Apostle Paul wrote to the Corinthians and all of us that we communicate with God’s third personality: the Holy Spirit.
Here is what my fellowship with God looks like:

1. I thank and praise God.
2. I read aloud a chapter or a part of a chapter from Psalms.
3. I confess and repent of my sins before God.
4. I seek God with all my heart, and when I feel His presence, I stop talking and ask the Holy Spirit to speak.
5. God speaks to me from the inside (as if through an internal telephone).
6. After this, I read a passage from the Old and New Testaments.
7. I pray for the needs of the church and for the government, starting with my street and ending with the President of my country.
8. I pray for my personal needs and my family's needs.
9. I end with thanksgiving.

God does not always start speaking right away. Sometimes, we need patience. Do not expect Him to talk with you about far galaxies or the problems of the African Zulu tribe. The conversation will resemble a conversation between a mother and a newborn. As you grow spiritually, the contents and subjects of the conversation will become more complex. But usually, God starts by saying He loves, values, and forgives you.
How to understand that God was speaking to you?

1. Thoughts come «from the inside,» not «from your head.»
2. Thoughts come by themselves, not from our efforts.
3. Thoughts have a clear and obvious meaning.
4. The style of words and sentences may differ from your manner of talk.
5. You feel God’s presence and power. Words clearly come from God.
6. Those thoughts never contradict the Bible.
Very often, I write down what I hear from God. I have a «Spiritual diary» for this.
God can speak to us not only through thoughts (look at Week 9, Lesson 1). He talks in a multifaceted way. The most important thing in fellowship with God is to open your heart completely.
What methods can be used for our conversations with God?
1. Through prayer and listening to the inner voice (Lesson 3)

2. Through a sermon during the church service. When you go to a service or before the sermon starts, ask God to speak to you personally through the Word you will hear. Take notes using a notebook or a digital device.

3. Through reading the Bible. We already talked about how you need to pray before reading the Bible to be able to receive revelations from God. After reading a passage from the Scripture, consider how it relates to your life.
4. Through gifts of the Spirit. Sudden revelations, knowledge, or reminders are a soft voice of God. Do not neglect it.
5. Through other people. Very often during a conversation you can feel that God is speaking directly to you and this conversation is not an accident.
During conversations, you can often feel that God is speaking to you directly, and this conversation is not an accident.
Of course, God has many other methods, but it is quality that matters, not quantity.

Once, when my house was under construction, and I was laying bricks while standing on scaffolding, God began to reveal the Sunday sermon to me. I climbed down, washed my hands, took off dirty clothing, and went to write down the revelation. Soon after returning to work, I heard God’s voice again and returned to write down what I heard. This repeated several times. The brother helping me asked, «Why are you running back and forth?» I said nothing because it was a revelation for me from my Lord.

God will deepen and widen His relationship with you only if you will value your fellowship with Him above all. Do not be lazy, and take notes! Buy the best notebook and pen for your meetings with the Lord! Show God that fellowship with Him is your first priority. The fellowship may fizzle out or never develop if you have a negligent attitude.

I want to remind you once again that God’s revelations never and in no way contradict the Bible. Examine your revelations. God has no objections if you do! Also, know that no revelation gives you the right to disobey your pastor or mentor.
The Bible is God’s ultimate revelation!
Did you learn to talk on the second day after you were born? How many months did it take you to learn to walk?
Apostle John wrote that we also go through certain stages of spiritual development.

When a person accepts Jesus, they become a newborn. There is so much they need to learn: living according to the Word, praying, receiving water baptism, hearing God’s voice, serving with the gifts, etc. All this takes time and persistence. The time it will take for us to become a boy, a young man, and a father depends on us. It may be 1 or 2 years or dozens of years. Your fellowship with God will not be built in one or two days. It is a lifelong commitment. There will be something new every day. If you found time for fellowship yesterday but failed today, the result will be little. God wants to deal with serious people.

Several years ago, I studied English with a small group of Christians. There were different people in the group: some were diligent, and others were not. One brother was able to speak and interpret very well after a year or two, but some did not understand or speak any English even after a long time. This man practiced English daily, while other people only did it when they had an opportunity. Some people may remain spiritual babies in a year, some in 10 years. Your spiritual age is determined not by how long you have been a Christian but by your spiritual growth in the Lord.

I recall a story told to me by a well-known preacher and evangelist. He served as a missionary in Siberia. There was a car accident, and a young woman was severely injured. There were no other cars close to the site of the accident, so this brother had to take this injured woman to a hospital, which was dozens of kilometers away. The whole time, the woman pleaded, «I want to live, I really want to live.» He did not understand the real meaning of her words and drove faster and faster. She died when they almost arrived at the hospital. Suddenly, he realized everything… God sent him to tell the woman about salvation. Christ did not want her to go to Hell and gave her a chance by sending this brother to her. Unfortunately, he did not say anything. Due to our silence and shyness, thousands and millions of people, young and old, go to Hell for eternal suffering. God does everything in His power for us to meet those people, but very often, instead of witnessing life in Jesus Christ to them, we keep silent or talk about meaningless things. The eternal death of this young woman weighs on the missionary’s conscience. How many lost people weigh on our conscience? May God help us to answer this question.
In verse 15, Jesus spoke about His most important Commandment, also known as «the Great Commission.» Let us review this Commission:
Go

Jesus did not tell us that people must come to us. We must go to them. Where do we have to go? Everywhere we live, work, travel, or serve as missionaries. Christ commissioned His Church to tell the Good News to the whole world!
Preach

Knowing what to preach is crucial. The Bible does not tell us to preach about a church, a good pastor, or a choir. It also does not tell us to show which church or denominational branches are better and so on. Jesus did not ask us to judge. He sent us to preach the Gospel. What do we need to tell people? Read Lesson 1 of Week 3. This is the Gospel: the salvation of people from sin, diseases, suffering, and eternal Hell through the Only Savior Jesus Christ!
Confirmation

In verse 20, it is said that the disciples went out and preached, and then God began to confirm His Word with great blessings! Many people were freed from demons, and many were healed of illnesses. There was supernatural wisdom in sermons and God’s powerful protection.
May the Lord help you fulfill His Great Commission at every time and place.

When we read the New Testament carefully, we can see that Jesus Christ not only preached but also helped the poor, healed, taught, and so on. Jesus was the King, but he often took on the role of a servant, doctor, advisor, and mentor. Let us review the big picture of the Gospel.
Four stages of evangelism

1. Prayer. We can not save anyone by our own efforts. Only God saves. Almost every person is controlled by demons, and their influence must be destroyed with the name of Jesus. This stage resembles plowing.
2. Good deeds. You need to show Jesus in action. People want to see change in our words and knowledge, but in our lives and deeds. We can compare this stage to fertilization.

3. Preaching. After praying and «fertilizing,» we need to talk about Jesus. I want to remind you that you need to tell people about Jesus, not about a denomination, debated topics, or a pastor. Only Jesus Christ gives salvation! Preaching resembles sowing.
4. Discipleship. After a person accepts Jesus as their Lord, we need to train them in God’s truth. The most effective way is discipleship. Discipleship can be compared to weeding and watering.

A non-believing family lived close to us. My wife and I prayed about their salvation for a long time. When we noticed a slight interest in us and God on their side, we began to help this family, even though they were wealthier. It touched them, and a short time later, the woman agreed to go to a church service. We continued to pray and help them in various ways. A while later, her husband came to «see where his wife is going.» The Lord touched their hearts, and they repented. My wife became a mentor for this family, which helped them grow spiritually, and soon, they started preparing to serve in the church.

Only a patient farmer will reap a good harvest. Seeds can be lost if sowed into unprepared soil or not cultivated and watered. Many of us have gardens and take care of them. People are so much more precious! They are in dire need of cultivation, weeding, and watering.
The devil puts many obstacles in the way of the Gospel. One of the biggest and most widespread ones is excessive shyness. Destroy this obstacle with the power of the Lord Jesus!
You can evangelize in three directions:
1. Your social circle. It includes your family, neighbors, co-workers or classmates, relatives, and friends.
Pray and carefully fill out the «My social circle» table.
The fourth column is for people who can become Christians very soon. Other people, if they are non-Christians, need your intensive prayer.

2. Chance meetings. On our way to work, a store, or on vacation, we meet hundreds of people. They need salvation, too! Pray, and God will show you who and when you can share the Gospel with. Always keep an invitation to the church, home church, and a copy of the New Testament with you. Pay attention: God will show you the needs of people, and you will be able to serve them.

3. Special evangelism meetings. Jesus preached not only to those people who came to Him. In most cases, He brought the Good News to the people. Organize such meetings in your home church, with your mentor, or with other brothers and sisters. You must pray for God’s revelations and His protection before the meeting. Do not be afraid. Be brave, and the Lord will use you in His great work of saving people!
Remember: no mission is more important, no goal is higher, and no ministry is greater than saving people.
Evangelism brings great joy. But this is not everything. God promised a big reward in Heaven and a hundredfold blessing on Earth.

Does the word «sacrifice» scare you? Apostle Paul does not write about some blood sacrifices here. He writes about complete dedication to ministry. In the New Testament, there is only one sacrifice in the literal sense: Jesus’ death on the cross!

Dedication means separation for a special purpose. There can be many blank notebooks on your bookshelf. They are not «dedicated» because they are not separated for a particular purpose. If you take a notebook and write «Prayer diary» or «Sunday sermons» on the cover and use it, then this notebook is separated or «dedicated» for a particular purpose.

People also dedicate their lives to different purposes, sometimes without even realizing it. How many people dedicate themselves to pumping alcohol through their bodies? How many think only about fornication, money, or other vain things? Many people dedicate their lives to widening their knowledge, receiving academic degrees, and publishing their works. Some completely gave themselves away to digital devices or the TV. There are adventurers who seek pirate treasure and gold veins their whole life. There are also many people who spend their lives in misery, not living but merely existing.

What did Jesus Christ dedicate His life to? It was for the salvation of you, me, and all people. What an honorable and noble purpose! There is no creation in the world more valuable than people and no purpose higher than their salvation.

Once, I spoke with a young woman. She was not opposed to the Gospel, but first, she wanted to have some more «fun» in life. When we began to talk about accepting Jesus as the Lord, the woman said, «I would like to, but not now. When I retire, I will repent right away!» I answered, «Would you want your husband or fiancé to answer you in that way, «I’m fine with becoming your husband, but I’d like to have more fun first, and when I retire, I’ll return to you, without teeth, and with a stick in my hand!». This young woman repented and began to serve the Lord.
What is your decision? What are you going to spend your time, health, and life on?
Do you want to join the millions-strong army of Christians for the salvation of people?
